title: First professional job with George Lewis
summary: Playing with Lewis was his first professional work; earlier jobs paid about five dollars.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional

blocks.x: Yeah. So we don't hear much of you before, say you started with the George Lewis band. Is that one of the first professional jobs you played? With George. With George. Yeah. That was the first professional jobs.
You didn't get paid when you were working with Harry Moran?
Yeah. But the money wasn't much though. It was five dollars or something like that, you know. Yeah.
After George took me on his wing, then we started making a little more money, you know. Yeah. Did you just- Well, at that time, George's popularity was growing then too.
